camel_example: aliyun sgw CreateGatewayFileShare --region cn-hangzhou --ShareProtocol NFS --OssEndpoint 'oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com' --OssBucketName testbucket --GatewayId 'gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq000' --LocalFilePath '/dev/vdb' --Name alex000
description_en: Creates a file share on a file gateway
description_zh: 在文件网关下创建文件共享
kebab_example: aliyun sgw create-gateway-file-share --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq000 --name alex000 --share-protocol NFS --oss-bucket-name testbucket --oss-endpoint oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com --local-file-path /dev/vdb --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGatewayFileShare

parameters.help_en: The gateway ID
parameters.help_zh: 网关ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the file share. The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享名称。长度限制1~255个字符，可以包含大小写字母，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The file share protocol. Valid values:

NFS

SMB
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享协议。取值范围：

NFS。

SMB
parameters.name: share_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether reverse synchronization is enabled for the file share. Valid values:

false (default): no

true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否打开反向同步。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否

true：是
parameters.name: remote_sync

parameters.help_en:
The reverse synchronization interval for the file share. Valid values: 15 to 36000.

If replication mode and reverse synchronization with file data download are enabled, the valid values are 3600 to 36000
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享反向同步时间间隔。取值范围为15~36000。

在复制模式+反向同步启用下载文件数据时，取值范围为3600~36000
parameters.name: polling_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether delete operations are ignored for the file share. If this feature is enabled, deleting a file on the gateway does not delete the corresponding file in OSS. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes

This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.0.40 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否忽略删除。启用后网关侧删除文件不会删除云上（OSS）对应文件。

false（默认）：否
true：是

网关版本大于等于1.0.40支持
parameters.name: ignore_delete

parameters.help_en: The maximum write speed of the file share. Unit: MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 1280. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享最大写入速度，单位为MB/s。取值范围为0~1280，默认值为0，表示无限制
parameters.name: frontend_limit

parameters.help_en:
The maximum upload speed of the file share. Unit: MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 1280. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit.
If the maximum write speed is limited, the maximum upload speed cannot be less than the maximum write speed
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享最大上传速度，单位为MB/s。取值范围为0~1280，默认值为0，表示无限制。
同时如果已限制最大写入速度，最大上传速度不能小于最大写入速度
parameters.name: backend_limit

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Do not set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，不建议设置
parameters.name: in_place

parameters.help_en:
The cache mode of the file share. Valid values:

Cache: cache mode

Sync: replication mode
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享缓存模式。取值范围如下：

Cache：缓存模式

Sync：复制模式
parameters.name: cache_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the file share is browsable over the SMB protocol, which means whether it can be discovered in Network Neighborhood. Valid values:

true (default): yes

false: no


This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下是否可浏览（即网络邻居中是否可发现），取值范围如下：

true（默认）：是

false：否


该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: browsable

parameters.help_en:
The user mapping for the file share over the NFS protocol. Valid values:

none (default)

root_squash

all_squash

all_anonymous
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享NFS协议下用户映射。取值范围如下：

none（默认）

root_squash

all_squash

all_anonymous
parameters.name: squash

parameters.help_en:
The list of users who have read and write permissions on the file share over the SMB protocol. Separate multiple users with commas (,).

This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下读写用户列表。多个用户使用逗号“,”分隔。

该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: read_write_user_list

parameters.help_en:
The list of users who have read-only permissions on the file share over the SMB protocol. Separate multiple users with commas (,).


This parameter is invalid for the NFS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下只读用户列表。多个用户使用逗号“,”分隔。


该参数在NFS协议下无效
parameters.name: read_only_user_list

parameters.help_en: The list of clients that have read and write permissions on the file share over the NFS protocol. You can specify IP addresses or IP address ranges. Separate multiple clients with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享NFS协议下读写客户端列表（可以是IP地址或者IP地址范围）。多个客户端使用逗号“,”分隔
parameters.name: read_write_client_list

parameters.help_en: The list of clients that have read-only permissions on the file share over the NFS protocol. You can specify IP addresses or IP address ranges. Separate multiple clients with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享NFS协议下只读客户端列表（可以是IP地址或者IP地址范围）。多个客户端使用“,”分隔
parameters.name: read_only_client_list

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket that corresponds to the file share.


File shares do not support OSS buckets of the Cold Archive storage class or OSS buckets that have the back-to-origin feature enabled.
If the multi-bucket aggregation feature is enabled, separate multiple bucket names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket名称。


文件共享不支持“冷归档类型”和“回源特性”的OSS桶。
开启多Bucket聚合功能时，多个OssBucketName请用逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the region where the OSS bucket that corresponds to the file share is located.
You can use an internal network or public endpoint. If the OSS bucket and the gateway are in the same region, use an internal network endpoint, such as oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket所在地域节点。
区分内网及外网Endpoint。建议如果OSS Bucket和网关处于相同Region则使用内网Endpoint：oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether SSL access to the OSS bucket is enabled for the file share. Valid values:

true (default): yes

false: no
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否启用SSL访问OSS Bucket。取值范围如下：

true（默认）：是

false：否
parameters.name: oss_bucket_ssl

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization latency, which is the delay for synchronizing data from the local cache of the gateway to OSS. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 120. Default value: 5.
This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.0.40 or later
parameters.help_zh:
同步延迟，即网关本地缓存同步到云上OSS的延迟时间。单位为秒。取值范围为5~120，默认值为5。
网关版本大于等于1.0.40支持
parameters.name: lag_period

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: direct_io

parameters.help_en: The internal device name of the cache disk used by the file share. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to obtain the device name
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享使用的缓存盘内部设备名，可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获取
parameters.name: local_file_path

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_encryption

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_cmk

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: client_side_encryption

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: client_side_cmk

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: kms_rotate_period

parameters.help_en: The subdirectory path in the OSS bucket that corresponds to the file share. If this parameter is left empty, the root directory of the bucket is used
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket下的子目录路径。为空则代表对应的是Bucket的根目录
parameters.name: path_prefix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether upload optimization is enabled for the file share. This feature is suitable for scenarios where data is used for pure backup to the cloud. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes

This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.0.39 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否开启上传优化，适合数据纯备份上云场景。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否
true：是

网关版本大于等于1.0.39支持
parameters.name: fast_reclaim

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Do not set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，不建议设置
parameters.name: support_archive

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether permission control by using Windows access control lists (ACLs) is enabled for the file share over the SMB protocol. This feature requires an Active Directory (AD) domain. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes

This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.0.45 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下，是否开启通过Windows访问列表（需要AD域）进行权限控制。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否
true：是

网关版本大于等于1.0.45支持
parameters.name: windows_acl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether Windows access-based enumeration (ABE) is enabled for the file share over the SMB protocol. This feature takes effect only when the WindowsAcl parameter is set to true. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes

This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.0.45 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享SMB协议下，是否启用Windows ABE，需要windowsAcl参数设置为true情况下生效。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否
true：是

网关版本大于等于1.0.45支持
parameters.name: access_based_enumeration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether NFS v4 optimization is enabled for the file share over the NFS protocol to improve the efficiency of mounting and uploading. Valid values:

false (default): no

true: yes

After this feature is enabled, mounting over NFS v3 is not supported. This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.2.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享NFS协议下，是否启用NFS v4优化，提升挂载上传效率。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否

true：是

开启后将不支持NFS v3形式挂载。网关版本大于等于1.2.0支持
parameters.name: nfs_v4_optimization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the transfer acceleration feature is enabled for the file share. This feature requires that transfer acceleration is enabled for the corresponding OSS bucket.
This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.3.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享是否开启传输加速功能，需要对应OSS Bucket已开启传输加速。
网关版本大于等于1.3.0支持
parameters.name: transfer_acceleration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to download file data in replication mode. Valid values:

false (default): no
true: yes

This parameter takes effect only when reverse synchronization is enabled for the share or the share is added to an express synchronization group
parameters.help_zh:
复制模式情况下，是否下载文件数据。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：否
true：是

只有当该共享打开了反向同步或者加入极速同步组时候，此参数才生效
parameters.name: remote_sync_download

parameters.help_en:
The maximum download speed of the file share. Unit: MB/s. Valid values: 0 to 1280. A value of 0 indicates no limit.
This parameter can be configured only in replication mode when file data download is enabled. - This parameter takes effect only when reverse synchronization is enabled for the file share or the file share is added to an express synchronization group. - This parameter is supported by gateways of version 1.3.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享最大下载速度，单位为MB/s。取值范围为0~1280，0表示无限制。
只在复制模式且开启下载文件数据的情况下才可设置。- 只有当该共享打开了反向同步或者加入极速同步组时候，此参数才生效。- 网关版本大于等于1.3.0支持
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en:
The collection of directory paths that use replication mode. Only the specified directories use replication mode.
To configure this parameter, contact Alibaba Cloud to apply for whitelist access
parameters.help_zh:
复制模式下，通过设置目录路径集合，指定仅有这些目录采用复制模式。
需要联系我们开启白名单后才可进行相关设置
parameters.name: partial_sync_paths

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: server_side_algorithm

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to read data directly from OSS. Valid values:

true: yes

false (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否直读OSS。取值范围如下：

true：是

false（默认）：否
parameters.name: bypass_cache_read

parameters.help_en: The virtual mount IP address bound to the share. This parameter is used only for high-availability gateways
parameters.help_zh: 仅高可用网关使用，设置共享绑定的虚拟挂载IP
parameters.name: bind_ip_addr

parameters.help_en:
The region where the OSS bucket that corresponds to the file share is located.

If the gateway version is 2.0.0 or later and this parameter is correctly specified, the gateway uses the OSS v4 signature algorithm to access data in the OSS bucket.
If the gateway version is earlier than 2.0.0 or this parameter is not correctly specified, the gateway uses the OSS v1 signature algorithm to access data in the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh:
文件共享对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket所在地域。

当网关版本大于等于2.0.0，并正确传入该参数，网关会使用OSS v4签名算法访问OSS桶中的数据。
当网关版本小于2.0.0，或未正确传入该参数，网关会使用OSS v1签名算法访问OSS桶中的数据
parameters.name: oss_bucket_region_id

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 废弃
parameters.name: bucket_infos

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-bucket aggregation. A value of false indicates that multi-bucket aggregation is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用多Bucket聚合。false表示不启用
parameters.name: bucket_stub

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
